scope: Independent frozen source-design/native-type/allocator-metadata review only. No helper implementation, pmap/getter execution, actual control PA derivation, provider configuration, physical page mutation or hardware admission.

checks.requirement: Known typed lock extent, not opaque-size guess
checks.evidence: Pinned IOLockAlloc returns lck_mtx_alloc_init, IOLockGetMachLock casts same pointer; supported IOKit export52. KDK private type probe proves sizeof16/align8. Actual kernel KT_LCK_MTX symbol mapped through Mach-O segment to typed-record kt_size16 using hash-bound source LP64 layout. This covers typed object and intersecting pages only, not allocator slab/turnstile/global memory.

Recorded failed public-first include is retained. Successful profile preincludes exact rxi private mach/vm_types then arm/locks before shared include guard; no invented struct or MACH_KERNEL_PRIVATE visibility shortcut. Actual object __text0, constants16/8/4/8/8, exact3symbol relocations match bound probe. No native call executed.

checks.requirement: Physical page number geometry and bounds
checks.evidence: Pinned pmap_find_phys returns uint32 ppnum_t from atop(pmap_find_pa). Actual kernel_pmap is const pmap_t. Require stable PAGE_SHIFT14/page_size16384; ppnum nonzero and<=0x3fffff, cast to64bit before shift14, full PApage fits below2^36. No32bit shift/truncation/offset double-count or DART PA>>12 confusion.

checks.requirement: Finite full page coverage and query budget
checks.evidence: Checked half-open CPU spans for exact anchor and16B aligned8 typed mutex; checked lastbyte/downalign enumeration, progress and overflow guards, dedup CPU page bases, max8unique or refuse, no truncation. Two identical-order passes require<=16page queries total. CPU-page sharing/PA aliases preserve exact full CPU coverage and conservative PA union.

checks.requirement: Canonical policy preservation and full-range validation
checks.evidence: Each full PApage must lie in one original declared RAM interval, below36bit limit and outside every original forbidden/reserved span. Preserve original RAM interval boundaries during containment and in final policy; do not merge adjacent RAM first to widen acceptance. Reserved/protection canonical unions may merge overlap/adjacency only, never bridge holes/drop reservations tofit8; refuse capacity overflow.

checks.requirement: Stable observations and atomic caller output
checks.evidence: Two passes compare all ppnums and immutable setup/base-policy/getter/kernel_pmap/page-profile identity at boundaries; failure leaves output unchanged and no configure. Output staged in caller-owned workspace, complete flag written only after all validations; fieldwise active ranges and zero tails, no padding-sensitive memcmp. Two passes detect sample changes only, not future immutability; wired boot lifetime/no-remap remains trusted.

checks.requirement: No unauthenticated native pointer queries before final configure
checks.evidence: Frozen provider has no read-only setup-authentication query, so validating a caller-provided setup only at final configure is too late for prior getter/pmap calls. Root-directed native wrapper must internally call pin_empty after pure workspace/base-policy preflight, derive only from its exact local immutable returned setup and then call configure once. Caller supplies no raw setup/address/detached receipt. No retry after pin, failure or unknown. Low-level injected algorithm is internal/test/trusted metadata only, not a real native raw-address entry point.

checks.requirement: Exact base/final policy and setup receipt binding
checks.evidence: Wrapper owns phase1 result; receipt ties actual setup identity/generation/typed spans/mutex/getter/profile and exact base+final policies to the derived CPU/PA vectors. No detached receipt accepted as authorization, no arbitrary complete1 input. Frozen raw configure remains publicly callable privileged bypass and its nonzero provenance label is not authentication; trusted wrapper call path must be enforced by future integration.

checks.requirement: Unsupported dependencies explicit and not hidden
checks.evidence: Exact exports: IOLockGetMachLock in IOKit52, kernel_pmap in Unsupported107, pmap_find_phys in Unsupported158. A small extern-C bridge repeats the actual source declaration with real private pmap_t; no guessed opaque type. Future kext must explicitly declare unsupported+actually needed KPI dependencies and verify exact collection imports. Current object package/provider/packet receives none implicitly.

checks.requirement: Read-only helper scope and source-first validation
checks.evidence: No data/IOBuffer allocations, prepare/complete, PTE/DART/MMIO writes, physical dereference, mapper registration, firmware/IRQ or unbounded retry. Only normal workspace/output writes and CPU queries. Future source tests must kill missing pages, pointer-size extent, ppnum/shift, omitted pass, alias loss, hole bridging/dropreservation and premature output; actual SDK combined link/import/frame proof remains pending.

required_implementation_clarifications_f.rule: High-level native wrapper owns bpn_native_pin_empty internally, only after pure policy/workspace validation. No caller rawsetup or address argument. Use only exact held local setup for native getter/pmap; call frozenconfigure once. Failure/unknown after pin has no retry or reinitialization. Low-level read_ops algorithm stays separate trusted/internal host-test interface.
required_implementation_clarifications_f.reason: Prevents the too-late configure identity check from allowing earlier arbitrary-pointer queries without changing frozen79 provider API.

required_implementation_clarifications_f.rule: Use caller-owned stable bounded workspace for full staged receipt, base+final policies and two8page vectors. No large automatic structs; target frame checks later.
required_implementation_clarifications_f.reason: Avoid large kernel stack copies and keep failure output all-or-nothing.

required_implementation_clarifications_f.rule: Full control-page containment uses original RAM intervals; preserve those boundaries. Canonicalize reserved/protection unions only by exact overlap/adjacency, no gap merging or reservation loss.
required_implementation_clarifications_f.reason: Merging adjacent RAM before containment could admit a whole page that fits neither original declared interval.

independently_checked_artifact_facts.scope: Static source/build metadata only. No live kernel address lookup or lock/provider function executed.

findings.detail: The frozen design's externally held setup wording alone is not native early-query authentication. R1 internal-pin ownership is required; the unclarified real raw-setup native wrapper is not admitted. No frozen design/core edits performed.

scope_limits: Typed mutex extent is established at current pin/config only; no allocator bucket/slab/turnstile/global-object completeness assertion
Stable two-pass samples do not replace permanent wired lifetime/no-remap discipline
Raw configure bypass remains technically possible to privileged components; wrapper is not a security boundary
Provenance is a setup-bound trusted label, not cryptographic proof or hardware authorization
No actual protection pages, pmap translation or native provider backing observed
No PCIe/chip/firmware/DART/DMA/IRQ/physical drain or hardware readiness
